interactions.note: CR1 scFv was obtained by selecting yeast-displayed mutants of the humanized affinity-matured AR2 scFv by increasing the affinity for BoNT/A2, while maintaining high affinity binding to BoNT/A1. The scFV KD to BoNT/A1 is 0.125 nM  and to BoNT/A2 is 0.4nM.  The ratio of affinities towards both subtypes was maintained when the scFv was converted to IgG.

AR2 scFv was obtained by selecting yeast-displayed mutants of the humanized C25 mAb by increasing the affinity for BoNT/A1.  AR2 binds BoNT/A1 with very high affinity and exhibits the highest level of in vivo neutralization, but has minimal neutralizing activity for BoNT/A2. The scFV KD to BoNT/A1 is 0.136 nM and to BoNT/A2 is 109 nM. The ratio of affinities towards both subtypes was maintained when the scFv was converted to IgG.

AR2 scFv was obtained by selecting yeast-displayed mutants of the humanized C25 mAb by increasing the affinity for BoNT/A1.  AR2 binds BoNT/A1 with very high affinity and exhibits the highest level of in vivo neutralization, but has minimal neutralizing activity for BoNT/A2. The IgG k<sub>a</sub> to BoNT/A1 is 3.7x10<sup>6</sup> M<sup>-1</sup> s<sup>-1</sup> and to BoNT/A2 is 8.31x10<sup>5</sup> M<sup>-1</sup> s<sup>-1</sup>.; Unmapped quantitative response: on rate 3700000 M^-1s^-1

The epitope specific yeast-displayed Aa1 VHH was selected for binding to botulinum neurotoxin serotype A light chain residues 1-448 by three rounds of sorting by flow cytometry. The affinity was determined to be Kd = 0.03 nM. The affinity of 15 selected VHH clones ranged from 230 nM to 30 pM.
The solution Kd and binding kinectics of epitope specific Aa1 VHH bound to BoNT/A Lc were determined by flow fluorimetry in a KinExA instrument.
